speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details; the combination of a pruritic rash on the upper body and face with neuropathic symptoms in the palms is concerning. Given your occupation working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, have you noticed any specific insects, plants, or chemical exposures that might trigger these symptoms? Also, do you experience joint pain or muscle weakness elsewhere?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, ESR, and ANA panel.
REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology full body photos focusing on upper body and face.
